Use declarative style. Base URL `https://api-platform.vntana.com`; auth header `X-AUTH-TOKEN`. All new operations must have unit tests. Run tests before any manual testing. Always verify API calls work. Only after curl verification succeeds. Always bump the version when committing changes to node code (`nodes/` or `credentials/`). GitHub repo must be public. Run the scanner locally first. All code must use `httpRequest`; `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed.

`npm run build`
`npm run dev`
`npm run lint`
`npm run lintfix`
`npm link`
`cd ~/.n8n/custom && npm link n8n-nodes-vntana`
`npm version patch`
`npm version minor`
`npm version major`
`git push origin main --tags`
`npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@latest`
